tenement.linePrev: I gave you documents and microfilm, too
tenement.line: And from my ten floor tenement
stanza: And from my ten floor tenement
How I long to hear you say
No, they'll never catch me now
No, they cannot catch me now

tenement.linePrev: Are written on the subway walls
tenement.lineNext: And whispered in the sound of silence"
stanza: And the people bowed and prayed
To the neon god they made
And the sign flashed out its warning
In the words that it was forming
And the sign said, "The words of the prophets
Are written on the subway walls
And whispered in the sound of silence"
